hero.subtitle: We build AI agents and production software for engineering and operations teams. Systems running live, not pilots stuck in PowerPoint.

manifesto.title: We build the foundry, not just the tools.
paragraphs: Vizcaia builds AI agents and production software for engineering and operations teams. We are not a consultancy that hands over a deck — we ship systems that run live, every day.

The name comes from the iron coast of northern Spain — a region that turned raw ore into the structures of the modern world. We do the same with raw signal: signal becomes structured intelligence; structured intelligence becomes labor; labor becomes leverage.
Our customers don't buy software. They buy the difference between what their team can do today and what becomes inevitable next quarter.

items.title: AI agents in production
items.lead: LLM-powered agents and assistants embedded in real workflows — not demos.
items.body: Custom retrieval, tool use, evaluation harness, observability. We ship the version your team uses every day, with the guardrails to keep it trustworthy.

items.title: Internal operating systems
items.lead: Backend, mobile, admin and BI delivered as a single coherent stack.
items.body: Designed around how your team actually operates. Replaces the spreadsheet-and-Slack stack with software engineers and operators trust.

items.title: AI architecture review
items.lead: Second opinion for teams with AI already in production but doubts about the stack.
items.body: Honest technical assessment, concrete recommendations, optional implementation if you want us to run it.

items.title: Specs before code
items.body: No mid-project surprises. We write down what we are going to build and why, before touching the editor.

items.title: Production from day 1
items.body: Demos prove ideas. Production proves systems. We optimize for the second from the first commit.

items.title: Honest about limits
items.body: We tell you what the model can do, what it cannot, and where it will fail. No magic words.

items.title: Living documentation
items.body: We hand off the operating manual, not just the code. Your team owns what we built after we leave.

work.title: Built in production.
work.lead: Production operating system serving hundreds of daily users across a distributed organization: backend, native mobile, admin console and BI dashboards as one stack. Replaced a legacy spreadsheet workflow and now runs the day-to-day operation end-to-end.
